title: The Ruined Quarry
text: An old quarry, flooded to the brim with green water, cut stone still stacked neatly at the edge as if waiting for a cart. Ropes trail from the stacks down into the water. They are taut, as if something below is holding them.

options.label: Take the stacked stone, cut and waiting as if for you.

outcomes.text: Already cut, and waiting, and nobody asks who it was waiting for.

options.label: The toughest dives along the taut ropes, to learn what holds them.

outcomes.text: A drowned quarryman's tools and coin, and the quarryman, still holding on.

options.label: Claim the quarry for the House, before another banner goes up.

outcomes.text: A rival House has a claim too, and now a grudge.
